item.title: course-placeholder Specification
item.description:
Purpose

Describe current MLOps course documentation and supported local commands.

Requirements

Requirement: Publish truthful course placeholder documentation

The project SHALL provide a README identifying it as an MLOps course and linking the user-supplied course page. After implementation it SHALL describe the runnable health service and its supported endpoints and startup command, rather than claiming that no code exists. Its documentation SHALL remain included through repository documentation targets. The local application SHALL NOT require a release deployment target.
